column4: Hey Daniel, did you get a chance to look at the budget for the March launch?
I did. Marketing wants forty thousand dollars, which feels high for a soft launch.
Agreed. What if we cut the paid ads and spend more on the community events instead?
That could work. The meetup in Brisbane last month brought in nearly two hundred sign ups.
Right, and it only cost us about three thousand dollars. Can you send me those numbers by Friday?
Sure, I'll put them in a spreadsheet tonight. Should I include the churn data too?
Yes please. Also, remind me who's handling the press release.
Priya is writing it. She said the first draft will be ready on Wednesday morning.
Perfect. Let's meet again on Thursday at two to make the final call.
Sounds good. I'll book the small meeting room and send out the invite.
One more thing. The investors asked for a demo of the new onboarding flow.
We can show the prototype. It's rough, but the sign up takes under ninety seconds now.
Great, that's exactly the kind of number they want to hear.
I'll also record a short video walkthrough in case the live demo breaks.
Smart. Last time the wifi in that office was terrible. Talk soon.
